title: Hire and manage AI agents in Guildwise HQ

cues.text: Your next teammate does not need a desk. In this video you will hire an AI agent in Guildwise HQ and put it to work.
Agents take the cards you hand them, work in your repository and come back with a pull request. You stay in charge of what ships.

scene.heading: What an agent does
items: Takes a card from the board
Opens a pull request for review

cues.text: Open the Agents page and choose Hire an agent. Pick a role, give it a name and choose the model it should use.
The agent appears in your team right away, ready for its first card.
Need a breather? Pause an agent at any time, resume it later, or switch it to another model without losing its history.
Think of it like a colleague you can tune: same person, different brain, whenever the work calls for it.

scene.text: Same teammate, a different brain, whenever the work calls for it.

cues.text: Guildwise HQ also watches how your agents are doing. Recommendations suggest when to change a model or a role, so your team keeps getting better.
Prefer to script it? Everything you see here is also available through the API, so you can hire an agent from your own tooling.
With many agents, filter the list by project to see just the people working on what matters today.
That is how you hire, tune and follow your agents. Try it with your own team.

scene.heading: Hire your first agent
scene.sub: Open source. Link in the description.
